meta.title: Looking Back
meta.description: The starlight's surface shatters, revealing a bloody red core. This sweetness and sorrow are mutually attractive.

units.rawText:
<color=#1E90FF>When we encounter a star, we are naturally attracted.</color><|>
<color=#1E90FF>When a star reaches its end, and gravity treks unto the extreme...</color><|>
<color=#1E90FF>Star-crumbs shall encircle you, until you are back at my side.</color><|>
units.displayText:
When we encounter a star, we are naturally attracted.
When a star reaches its end, and gravity treks unto the extreme...
Star-crumbs shall encircle you, until you are back at my side.

spans.text: When we encounter a star, we are naturally attracted.
When a star reaches its end, and gravity treks unto the extreme...
Star-crumbs shall encircle you, until you are back at my side.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Ah, your expression does not seem to indicate agreement...</color>
units.displayText: Ah, your expression does not seem to indicate agreement...

spans.text: Ah, your expression does not seem to indicate agreement...

units.rawText: The spaceship continues to contend with the planet's gravity. Through the spaceship's window, I look once more at the friend we were reunited with.
units.displayText: The spaceship continues to contend with the planet's gravity. Through the spaceship's window, I look once more at the friend we were reunited with.

spans.text: The spaceship continues to contend with the planet's gravity. Through the spaceship's window, I look once more at the friend we were reunited with.

units.rawText: I see Hubble. I also see an Entropic, in its full capacity.
units.displayText: I see Hubble. I also see an Entropic, in its full capacity.

spans.text: I see Hubble. I also see an Entropic, in its full capacity.

units.rawText:
She is our friend, on a journey to retrieve memories we once made.
She is also an Entropic in control of this Starsphere, intent on eternally confining us here.
units.displayText:
She is our friend, on a journey to retrieve memories we once made.
She is also an Entropic in control of this Starsphere, intent on eternally confining us here.

spans.text:
She is our friend, on a journey to retrieve memories we once made.
She is also an Entropic in control of this Starsphere, intent on eternally confining us here.

units.rawText: Antonina, how long do we need to finish the analysis on that planet?
units.displayText: Antonina, how long do we need to finish the analysis on that planet?

spans.text: Antonina, how long do we need to finish the analysis on that planet?

units.rawText: I'm working on it... with the basis we have from research on the little guy, our progress is much faster than expected!
units.displayText: I'm working on it... with the basis we have from research on the little guy, our progress is much faster than expected!

spans.text: I'm working on it... with the basis we have from research on the little guy, our progress is much faster than expected!

units.rawText: Before I find a way to dismantle it, you better hang on!
units.displayText: Before I find a way to dismantle it, you better hang on!

spans.text: Before I find a way to dismantle it, you better hang on!

units.rawText: That dark red planet tacitly hovers, its agape eye unmoving, as if holding back the mockery of its trapped prey.
units.displayText: That dark red planet tacitly hovers, its agape eye unmoving, as if holding back the mockery of its trapped prey.

spans.text: That dark red planet tacitly hovers, its agape eye unmoving, as if holding back the mockery of its trapped prey.

units.rawText: The data this red planet holds isn't quite the same as what we detected before...
units.displayText: The data this red planet holds isn't quite the same as what we detected before...

spans.text: The data this red planet holds isn't quite the same as what we detected before...

units.rawText: ...Inside-out Entropization! Is it that, once again?
units.displayText: ...Inside-out Entropization! Is it that, once again?

spans.text: ...Inside-out Entropization! Is it that, once again?

units.rawText: Before that "eye" opened, she had countless ways to hide that planet's true form...
units.displayText: Before that "eye" opened, she had countless ways to hide that planet's true form...

spans.text: Before that "eye" opened, she had countless ways to hide that planet's true form...

units.rawText: Dammit, it's all gone wrong! We were caught in her ploy from the very beginning!
units.displayText: Dammit, it's all gone wrong! We were caught in her ploy from the very beginning!

spans.text: Dammit, it's all gone wrong! We were caught in her ploy from the very beginning!

units.rawText: The Entropic Core is a complete string of data, and our analysis system functioned on the basis of other Entropic Cores.
units.displayText: The Entropic Core is a complete string of data, and our analysis system functioned on the basis of other Entropic Cores.

spans.text: The Entropic Core is a complete string of data, and our analysis system functioned on the basis of other Entropic Cores.

units.rawText: But Hubble, chances are... she never had a complete Entropic Core!
units.displayText: But Hubble, chances are... she never had a complete Entropic Core!

spans.text: But Hubble, chances are... she never had a complete Entropic Core!

units.rawText: So, back then...
units.displayText: So, back then...

spans.text: So, back then...

units.rawText: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...
units.displayText: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...

spans.text: It is... a very special star. I cannot fully grasp it either...

units.rawText: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.
units.displayText: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.

spans.text: From slumber, to awakening... from shattered, to fused.

units.rawText: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.
units.displayText: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.

spans.text: Except if it approaches you of its own will, this little spaceship will never chase it down.

units.rawText: "Cannot fully grasp", but she isn't unaware of where it is. We couldn't "chase it down", but that doesn't mean it can't be stopped.
units.displayText: "Cannot fully grasp", but she isn't unaware of where it is. We couldn't "chase it down", but that doesn't mean it can't be stopped.

spans.text: "Cannot fully grasp", but she isn't unaware of where it is. We couldn't "chase it down", but that doesn't mean it can't be stopped.

units.rawText: And if she wills it, then "approaching you of its own will" is possible too...
units.displayText: And if she wills it, then "approaching you of its own will" is possible too...

spans.text: And if she wills it, then "approaching you of its own will" is possible too...

units.rawText: We've got our comparison data from our analysis here. The real "core" is on that planet, in the center of the eye.
units.displayText: We've got our comparison data from our analysis here. The real "core" is on that planet, in the center of the eye.

spans.text: We've got our comparison data from our analysis here. The real "core" is on that planet, in the center of the eye.

units.rawText: Hubble's personal data back then was incomplete too, so we couldn't locate the core through her...
units.displayText: Hubble's personal data back then was incomplete too, so we couldn't locate the core through her...

spans.text: Hubble's personal data back then was incomplete too, so we couldn't locate the core through her...

units.rawText: Hubble's data collection progress has most likely accelerated the Entropic Core's development progress.
units.displayText: Hubble's data collection progress has most likely accelerated the Entropic Core's development progress.

spans.text: Hubble's data collection progress has most likely accelerated the Entropic Core's development progress.

units.rawText: Those two things likely progressed in sync.
units.displayText: Those two things likely progressed in sync.

spans.text: Those two things likely progressed in sync.

units.rawText: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.
units.displayText: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

spans.text: So what if I could? Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

units.rawText: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.
units.displayText: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.

spans.text: By the time you arrive, they are in another place altogether.

units.rawText: ...So Hubble had been using us to progress her toward this end all along.
units.displayText: ...So Hubble had been using us to progress her toward this end all along.

spans.text: ...So Hubble had been using us to progress her toward this end all along.

units.rawText: It was precisely because she was always with us that she could manipulate her Entropic Core to avoid detection.
units.displayText: It was precisely because she was always with us that she could manipulate her Entropic Core to avoid detection.

spans.text: It was precisely because she was always with us that she could manipulate her Entropic Core to avoid detection.

units.rawText: As expected of Hubble. It was a game of words all along...
units.displayText: As expected of Hubble. It was a game of words all along...

spans.text: As expected of Hubble. It was a game of words all along...

units.rawText: Hehehe... still making your assumptions?
units.displayText: Hehehe... still making your assumptions?

spans.text: Hehehe... still making your assumptions?

units.rawText: I already told you. Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.
units.displayText: I already told you. Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

spans.text: I already told you. Each and every star in this dream wanders on their own path.

units.rawText: I wonder how close you are to the truth, with all your assumptions and tales combined? Though that matters little now.
units.displayText: I wonder how close you are to the truth, with all your assumptions and tales combined? Though that matters little now.

spans.text: I wonder how close you are to the truth, with all your assumptions and tales combined? Though that matters little now.

units.rawText: Reunited with my alien star, and a core fully formed. I finally have complete control of this dream.
units.displayText: Reunited with my alien star, and a core fully formed. I finally have complete control of this dream.

spans.text: Reunited with my alien star, and a core fully formed. I finally have complete control of this dream.

units.rawText: Now, it is time to welcome you back into my embrace.
units.displayText: Now, it is time to welcome you back into my embrace.

spans.text: Now, it is time to welcome you back into my embrace.

units.rawText: The dark-red planet radiates a calamitous aura, and the spaceship's alarms successively ring.
units.displayText: The dark-red planet radiates a calamitous aura, and the spaceship's alarms successively ring.

spans.text: The dark-red planet radiates a calamitous aura, and the spaceship's alarms successively ring.

units.rawText: Antonina, what's your progress on the analysis!
units.displayText: Antonina, what's your progress on the analysis!

spans.text: Antonina, what's your progress on the analysis!

units.rawText: We'll make it, we'll make it... I just hope that we make it in time!
units.displayText: We'll make it, we'll make it... I just hope that we make it in time!

spans.text: We'll make it, we'll make it... I just hope that we make it in time!

units.rawText: I'm already calculating... just a little bit more!
units.displayText: I'm already calculating... just a little bit more!

spans.text: I'm already calculating... just a little bit more!

units.rawText: Astral tides flow and star-crumbs fly, the million forms of matter inside the Starsphere homing in on Hubble. She smiles with satisfaction, only to be interrupted by a voice that had disappeared for some time.
units.displayText: Astral tides flow and star-crumbs fly, the million forms of matter inside the Starsphere homing in on Hubble. She smiles with satisfaction, only to be interrupted by a voice that had disappeared for some time.

spans.text: Astral tides flow and star-crumbs fly, the million forms of matter inside the Starsphere homing in on Hubble. She smiles with satisfaction, only to be interrupted by a voice that had disappeared for some time.

units.rawText: Is that your decision?
units.displayText: Is that your decision?

spans.text: Is that your decision?

units.rawText: Fresnel returns to the spaceship via the tether. She makes good speed towards the window, taking a long look at Hubble, placing her hand on the combat module's interface.
units.displayText: Fresnel returns to the spaceship via the tether. She makes good speed towards the window, taking a long look at Hubble, placing her hand on the combat module's interface.

spans.text: Fresnel returns to the spaceship via the tether. She makes good speed towards the window, taking a long look at Hubble, placing her hand on the combat module's interface.

units.rawText: ...Hubble. All this time, were your emotional fluxes fake too?
units.displayText: ...Hubble. All this time, were your emotional fluxes fake too?

spans.text: ...Hubble. All this time, were your emotional fluxes fake too?

units.rawText: Stars do not lie and speak in riddles, Fresnel. The one who does not understand has always been you, not me.
units.displayText: Stars do not lie and speak in riddles, Fresnel. The one who does not understand has always been you, not me.

spans.text: Stars do not lie and speak in riddles, Fresnel. The one who does not understand has always been you, not me.

units.rawText: Our orbits were not meant to cross again, but here you are again before me...
units.displayText: Our orbits were not meant to cross again, but here you are again before me...

spans.text: Our orbits were not meant to cross again, but here you are again before me...

units.rawText: I felt rich emotions, and an impassible rampart.
units.displayText: I felt rich emotions, and an impassible rampart.

spans.text: I felt rich emotions, and an impassible rampart.

units.rawText: I am an Entropic. Differing from you, I've already been burned to the ground.
units.displayText: I am an Entropic. Differing from you, I've already been burned to the ground.

spans.text: I am an Entropic. Differing from you, I've already been burned to the ground.

units.rawText: To remove that rampart, we should always, always be together. That is the best outcome.
units.displayText: To remove that rampart, we should always, always be together. That is the best outcome.

spans.text: To remove that rampart, we should always, always be together. That is the best outcome.

units.rawText: So... that's what you left unsaid all that time.
units.displayText: So... that's what you left unsaid all that time.

spans.text: So... that's what you left unsaid all that time.

units.rawText:
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
units.displayText:
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]

spans.text:
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]
[Incoming attack, evasive action]

units.rawText: Before Fresnel is finished, the contact between us and Hubble cuts off once and for all.
units.displayText: Before Fresnel is finished, the contact between us and Hubble cuts off once and for all.

spans.text: Before Fresnel is finished, the contact between us and Hubble cuts off once and for all.

units.rawText: Hubble leverages a finger at us again. Her purple light is far more intense than ever before, rushing towards us from her shattered telescope.
units.displayText: Hubble leverages a finger at us again. Her purple light is far more intense than ever before, rushing towards us from her shattered telescope.

spans.text: Hubble leverages a finger at us again. Her purple light is far more intense than ever before, rushing towards us from her shattered telescope.

units.rawText: Steady, Fresnel!
units.displayText: Steady, Fresnel!

spans.text: Steady, Fresnel!

units.rawText: I prepare the defense again, fighting alongside Fresnel. Fending off Hubble's attacks, the spaceship struggles to make the necessary evasive motions.
units.displayText: I prepare the defense again, fighting alongside Fresnel. Fending off Hubble's attacks, the spaceship struggles to make the necessary evasive motions.

spans.text: I prepare the defense again, fighting alongside Fresnel. Fending off Hubble's attacks, the spaceship struggles to make the necessary evasive motions.

units.rawText: Hang on, whatever it takes! This is a damn mess... just a little more!
units.displayText: Hang on, whatever it takes! This is a damn mess... just a little more!

spans.text: Hang on, whatever it takes! This is a damn mess... just a little more!

units.rawText: Wait, this signal...
units.displayText: Wait, this signal...

spans.text: Wait, this signal...

units.rawText: Gagarin! Gagarin is on that red planet!
units.displayText: Gagarin! Gagarin is on that red planet!

spans.text: Gagarin! Gagarin is on that red planet!

units.rawText: How... that only makes it more chaotic!
units.displayText: How... that only makes it more chaotic!

spans.text: How... that only makes it more chaotic!

units.rawText: Why is it there...
units.displayText: Why is it there...

spans.text: Why is it there...

units.rawText: Entropic... Entropic attack...
units.displayText: Entropic... Entropic attack...

spans.text: Entropic... Entropic attack...

units.rawText: Guard... where... Entropics are many...
units.displayText: Guard... where... Entropics are many...

spans.text: Guard... where... Entropics are many...

units.rawText: Send... message to...
units.displayText: Send... message to...

spans.text: Send... message to...

units.rawText: The planet Entropizing from inside out... was the last thing it saw.
units.displayText: The planet Entropizing from inside out... was the last thing it saw.

spans.text: The planet Entropizing from inside out... was the last thing it saw.

units.rawText: It's been chasing after these things!
units.displayText: It's been chasing after these things!

spans.text: It's been chasing after these things!

units.rawText: Professor, the cannon can't lock onto the Entropic Core!
units.displayText: Professor, the cannon can't lock onto the Entropic Core!

spans.text: Professor, the cannon can't lock onto the Entropic Core!

units.rawText: If that's the case...
units.displayText: If that's the case...

spans.text: If that's the case...

units.rawText: Fresnel, give up fighting head-on, for now; listen to my commands!
units.displayText: Fresnel, give up fighting head-on, for now; listen to my commands!

spans.text: Fresnel, give up fighting head-on, for now; listen to my commands!

units.rawText: Eh!? Wh... I got it!
units.displayText: Eh!? Wh... I got it!

spans.text: Eh!? Wh... I got it!

units.rawText: She grits her teeth, leaving the combat module with the system, awaiting my orders as the spaceship shakes vigorously.
units.displayText: She grits her teeth, leaving the combat module with the system, awaiting my orders as the spaceship shakes vigorously.

spans.text: She grits her teeth, leaving the combat module with the system, awaiting my orders as the spaceship shakes vigorously.

units.rawText: We're sending the little Entropic onto "Ghroth".
units.displayText: We're sending the little Entropic onto "Ghroth".

spans.text: We're sending the little Entropic onto "Ghroth".

units.rawText: What madness grips you at a time like this...
units.displayText: What madness grips you at a time like this...

spans.text: What madness grips you at a time like this...

units.rawText: Gagarin's more neurally capable than the average Agent. We could perhaps use it to get a target lock.
units.displayText: Gagarin's more neurally capable than the average Agent. We could perhaps use it to get a target lock.

spans.text: Gagarin's more neurally capable than the average Agent. We could perhaps use it to get a target lock.

units.rawText: If we can, we'll get the little Entropic to drag Gagarin back!
units.displayText: If we can, we'll get the little Entropic to drag Gagarin back!

spans.text: If we can, we'll get the little Entropic to drag Gagarin back!

units.rawText: Who the hell can pull off that kind of move?
units.displayText: Who the hell can pull off that kind of move?

spans.text: Who the hell can pull off that kind of move?

units.rawText: I'll go!
units.displayText: I'll go!

spans.text: I'll go!

units.rawText: I'll provide support. Hang tightly onto the tether. If it really isn't serviceable, I'll pull you...
units.displayText: I'll provide support. Hang tightly onto the tether. If it really isn't serviceable, I'll pull you...

spans.text: I'll provide support. Hang tightly onto the tether. If it really isn't serviceable, I'll pull you...

units.rawText: ...There's no need for that trouble.
units.displayText: ...There's no need for that trouble.

spans.text: ...There's no need for that trouble.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Jiutian's Agents are largely equipped with self-destruct sequences...
units.displayText: Jiutian's Agents are largely equipped with self-destruct sequences...

spans.text: Jiutian's Agents are largely equipped with self-destruct sequences...

units.rawText: I can... provide the command, and you need only send it to Gagarin.
units.displayText: I can... provide the command, and you need only send it to Gagarin.

spans.text: I can... provide the command, and you need only send it to Gagarin.

units.rawText: As an Agent, perhaps it doesn't receive orders from an Administrator anymore... but as an Entropic, it will likely listen to messages from another Entropic.
units.displayText: As an Agent, perhaps it doesn't receive orders from an Administrator anymore... but as an Entropic, it will likely listen to messages from another Entropic.

spans.text: As an Agent, perhaps it doesn't receive orders from an Administrator anymore... but as an Entropic, it will likely listen to messages from another Entropic.

units.rawText: ...Are these Jiutian's failsafes?
units.displayText: ...Are these Jiutian's failsafes?

spans.text: ...Are these Jiutian's failsafes?

units.rawText: Each and every line of code in my being rejects this... but... I have no other choice.
units.displayText: Each and every line of code in my being rejects this... but... I have no other choice.

spans.text: Each and every line of code in my being rejects this... but... I have no other choice.

units.rawText: As Xuannu, my personal desires have never been of any worth. As Jiutian's Administrator, I solemnly request that you... bring back Gagarin.
units.displayText: As Xuannu, my personal desires have never been of any worth. As Jiutian's Administrator, I solemnly request that you... bring back Gagarin.

spans.text: As Xuannu, my personal desires have never been of any worth. As Jiutian's Administrator, I solemnly request that you... bring back Gagarin.

units.rawText: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian.
units.displayText: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian.

spans.text: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian.

units.rawText: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.
units.displayText: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.

spans.text: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.

units.rawText: Go, Fresnel.
units.displayText: Go, Fresnel.

spans.text: Go, Fresnel.

units.rawText: Fresnel attaches her tether once more, holding tight the anxious and startled miniature Entropic. The order blinks with red light, tightly clasped in its tendrils.
units.displayText: Fresnel attaches her tether once more, holding tight the anxious and startled miniature Entropic. The order blinks with red light, tightly clasped in its tendrils.

spans.text: Fresnel attaches her tether once more, holding tight the anxious and startled miniature Entropic. The order blinks with red light, tightly clasped in its tendrils.

units.rawText: Professor! We need to be a bit closer!
units.displayText: Professor! We need to be a bit closer!

spans.text: Professor! We need to be a bit closer!

units.rawText: The information panel rattles in the turbulence, Gagarin's signal still tightly bound to that grim eye upon the planet. I open the cabin door as the spaceship's trajectory dips downwards, quickly.
units.displayText: The information panel rattles in the turbulence, Gagarin's signal still tightly bound to that grim eye upon the planet. I open the cabin door as the spaceship's trajectory dips downwards, quickly.

spans.text: The information panel rattles in the turbulence, Gagarin's signal still tightly bound to that grim eye upon the planet. I open the cabin door as the spaceship's trajectory dips downwards, quickly.

units.rawText: Go! Complete our mission... and Gagarin's!
units.displayText: Go! Complete our mission... and Gagarin's!

spans.text: Go! Complete our mission... and Gagarin's!

units.rawText: Fresnel makes a leap of faith.
units.displayText: Fresnel makes a leap of faith.

spans.text: Fresnel makes a leap of faith.

units.rawText: Hubble's attacks continue. Perhaps it's Fresnel's figure being too minute and far away. Perhaps everything is in her control. Perhaps she is already sinking into disarray in her current state—
units.displayText: Hubble's attacks continue. Perhaps it's Fresnel's figure being too minute and far away. Perhaps everything is in her control. Perhaps she is already sinking into disarray in her current state—

spans.text: Hubble's attacks continue. Perhaps it's Fresnel's figure being too minute and far away. Perhaps everything is in her control. Perhaps she is already sinking into disarray in her current state—

units.rawText: What... are you doing?
units.displayText: What... are you doing?

spans.text: What... are you doing?

units.rawText: Why there...
units.displayText: Why there...

spans.text: Why there...

units.rawText: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.
units.displayText: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.

spans.text: The spaceship continues to convulse as silence descends, only that ever-so-important order blinking on the panel.

units.rawText: Almost...
units.displayText: Almost...

spans.text: Almost...

units.rawText: Sqqqqueak! Squeak!!
units.displayText: Sqqqqueak! Squeak!!

spans.text: Sqqqqueak! Squeak!!

units.rawText: The command's maximum range... Gagarin's right here!
units.displayText: The command's maximum range... Gagarin's right here!

spans.text: The command's maximum range... Gagarin's right here!

units.rawText: ...Jiutian...
units.displayText: ...Jiutian...

spans.text: ...Jiutian...

units.rawText: Glory...
units.displayText: Glory...

spans.text: Glory...

units.rawText: Hubble's attacks never cease. The nebulae tremble, and the world shudders violently.
units.displayText: Hubble's attacks never cease. The nebulae tremble, and the world shudders violently.

spans.text: Hubble's attacks never cease. The nebulae tremble, and the world shudders violently.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you... this time as well!
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you... this time as well!

spans.text: I'll be counting on you... this time as well!

units.rawText: Sqqqqqueal—
units.displayText: Sqqqqqueal—

spans.text: Sqqqqqueal—

units.rawText: The moment before the spaceship is engulfed by the planet's surface covered with surging gas—
units.displayText: The moment before the spaceship is engulfed by the planet's surface covered with surging gas—

spans.text: The moment before the spaceship is engulfed by the planet's surface covered with surging gas—

units.rawText: Smoke and clouds billow, and the world shakes to its very roots.
units.displayText: Smoke and clouds billow, and the world shakes to its very roots.

spans.text: Smoke and clouds billow, and the world shakes to its very roots.

units.rawText: My core—
units.displayText: My core—

spans.text: My core—

units.rawText: Entry successful!
units.displayText: Entry successful!

spans.text: Entry successful!

units.rawText: Perhaps we were truly that close to disaster. Perhaps we were still safe. With a distance where safety is unknowable, Gagarin sends one last feedback signal.
units.displayText: Perhaps we were truly that close to disaster. Perhaps we were still safe. With a distance where safety is unknowable, Gagarin sends one last feedback signal.

spans.text: Perhaps we were truly that close to disaster. Perhaps we were still safe. With a distance where safety is unknowable, Gagarin sends one last feedback signal.

units.rawText: The final successful self-destruct.
units.displayText: The final successful self-destruct.

spans.text: The final successful self-destruct.

units.rawText: We never got a good look at Gagarin.
units.displayText: We never got a good look at Gagarin.

spans.text: We never got a good look at Gagarin.

units.rawText: It's done... Gagarin...
units.displayText: It's done... Gagarin...

spans.text: It's done... Gagarin...

units.rawText: Professor! Altitude, now!!
units.displayText: Professor! Altitude, now!!

spans.text: Professor! Altitude, now!!

units.rawText: The explosion in the middle of the eye blooms upwards, its impact expanding outwards in waves. It is not large, but it has the power it needs—
units.displayText: The explosion in the middle of the eye blooms upwards, its impact expanding outwards in waves. It is not large, but it has the power it needs—

spans.text: The explosion in the middle of the eye blooms upwards, its impact expanding outwards in waves. It is not large, but it has the power it needs—

units.rawText: On the Analysis System's progress panel, the most difficult part of the bar to overcome finally fills.
units.displayText: On the Analysis System's progress panel, the most difficult part of the bar to overcome finally fills.

spans.text: On the Analysis System's progress panel, the most difficult part of the bar to overcome finally fills.

units.rawText: The planet will crumble soon, we've done it!
units.displayText: The planet will crumble soon, we've done it!

spans.text: The planet will crumble soon, we've done it!

units.rawText: Give me a bit of time. All we need to do is demerge Hubble's core data and the Entropic Core's data structures!
units.displayText: Give me a bit of time. All we need to do is demerge Hubble's core data and the Entropic Core's data structures!

spans.text: Give me a bit of time. All we need to do is demerge Hubble's core data and the Entropic Core's data structures!

units.rawText: No, wait. Hubble, she's...
units.displayText: No, wait. Hubble, she's...

spans.text: No, wait. Hubble, she's...

units.rawText: She plans to stay on that planet!
units.displayText: She plans to stay on that planet!

spans.text: She plans to stay on that planet!

units.rawText: ...Professor, you can't let her stay there! The data demerge isn't complete yet!
units.displayText: ...Professor, you can't let her stay there! The data demerge isn't complete yet!

spans.text: ...Professor, you can't let her stay there! The data demerge isn't complete yet!

units.rawText: She'll disintegrate along with that thing!
units.displayText: She'll disintegrate along with that thing!

spans.text: She'll disintegrate along with that thing!

units.rawText: As the Entropic Core shatters, cracks begin to surface on the crimson planet. As the demerge progresses, the planet's eye dissipates into surging seas, its valleys and ridges disintegrating into broken stone. As the source of her power fades, Hubble's attacks cease with it.
units.displayText: As the Entropic Core shatters, cracks begin to surface on the crimson planet. As the demerge progresses, the planet's eye dissipates into surging seas, its valleys and ridges disintegrating into broken stone. As the source of her power fades, Hubble's attacks cease with it.

spans.text: As the Entropic Core shatters, cracks begin to surface on the crimson planet. As the demerge progresses, the planet's eye dissipates into surging seas, its valleys and ridges disintegrating into broken stone. As the source of her power fades, Hubble's attacks cease with it.

units.rawText: Rejected, I see... it's only fair.
units.displayText: Rejected, I see... it's only fair.

spans.text: Rejected, I see... it's only fair.

units.rawText: She gazes upon the planet beneath her feet, smiling with loneliness in her countenance. She takes out that piece of starlight chocolate, slowly depositing it between her lips.
units.displayText: She gazes upon the planet beneath her feet, smiling with loneliness in her countenance. She takes out that piece of starlight chocolate, slowly depositing it between her lips.

spans.text: She gazes upon the planet beneath her feet, smiling with loneliness in her countenance. She takes out that piece of starlight chocolate, slowly depositing it between her lips.

units.rawText: How sweet... how bitter.
units.displayText: How sweet... how bitter.

spans.text: How sweet... how bitter.

units.rawText: To fade like this is a star's destiny, too... hehe, this isn't so bad.
units.displayText: To fade like this is a star's destiny, too... hehe, this isn't so bad.

spans.text: To fade like this is a star's destiny, too... hehe, this isn't so bad.

units.rawText: Hubble covers her eyes, falling towards the dark red rubble. She sinks down in nothingness, towards a dream from which one never wakes.
units.displayText: Hubble covers her eyes, falling towards the dark red rubble. She sinks down in nothingness, towards a dream from which one never wakes.

spans.text: Hubble covers her eyes, falling towards the dark red rubble. She sinks down in nothingness, towards a dream from which one never wakes.

units.rawText: Until tiny tendrils make contact with her fingertips. Hubble opens her eyes, finding herself in a gentle and firm embrace.
units.displayText: Until tiny tendrils make contact with her fingertips. Hubble opens her eyes, finding herself in a gentle and firm embrace.

spans.text: Until tiny tendrils make contact with her fingertips. Hubble opens her eyes, finding herself in a gentle and firm embrace.

units.rawText: Got you.
units.displayText: Got you.

spans.text: Got you.

units.rawText: Fresnel?
units.displayText: Fresnel?

spans.text: Fresnel?

units.rawText: The spaceship is parked not far away. A drawn-out tether connects it to Fresnel. The miniature Entropic clambers out of her lap, intimately entwined between Hubble's fingers.
units.displayText: The spaceship is parked not far away. A drawn-out tether connects it to Fresnel. The miniature Entropic clambers out of her lap, intimately entwined between Hubble's fingers.

spans.text: The spaceship is parked not far away. A drawn-out tether connects it to Fresnel. The miniature Entropic clambers out of her lap, intimately entwined between Hubble's fingers.

units.rawText: Fresnel binds herself closely to Hubble, dragging her away from the disintegrating planet.
units.displayText: Fresnel binds herself closely to Hubble, dragging her away from the disintegrating planet.

spans.text: Fresnel binds herself closely to Hubble, dragging her away from the disintegrating planet.

units.rawText: If it wasn't for the Professor's swift reactions, you'd have escaped us again.
units.displayText: If it wasn't for the Professor's swift reactions, you'd have escaped us again.

spans.text: If it wasn't for the Professor's swift reactions, you'd have escaped us again.

units.rawText: I see... one step ahead.
units.displayText: I see... one step ahead.

spans.text: I see... one step ahead.

units.rawText: To be honest, I've been thinking about something you said, Hubble. I think you're right about one thing.
units.displayText: To be honest, I've been thinking about something you said, Hubble. I think you're right about one thing.

spans.text: To be honest, I've been thinking about something you said, Hubble. I think you're right about one thing.

units.rawText: Maybe I really just "don't understand".
units.displayText: Maybe I really just "don't understand".

spans.text: Maybe I really just "don't understand".

units.rawText: ...What?
units.displayText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: I never really "understood" your ways of thinking.
units.displayText: I never really "understood" your ways of thinking.

spans.text: I never really "understood" your ways of thinking.

units.rawText: From way back, before we were separated, I didn't understand your choices. Your dedication and love for space and the Sectors... why did you never elaborate upon them?
units.displayText: From way back, before we were separated, I didn't understand your choices. Your dedication and love for space and the Sectors... why did you never elaborate upon them?

spans.text: From way back, before we were separated, I didn't understand your choices. Your dedication and love for space and the Sectors... why did you never elaborate upon them?

units.rawText: This continued, all the way until our moment of separation. I was pushed far away, by things you had hidden deep... to somewhere safe.
units.displayText: This continued, all the way until our moment of separation. I was pushed far away, by things you had hidden deep... to somewhere safe.

spans.text: This continued, all the way until our moment of separation. I was pushed far away, by things you had hidden deep... to somewhere safe.

units.rawText: Even back then, you liked to deal with those things discreetly by yourself... with no one noticing.
units.displayText: Even back then, you liked to deal with those things discreetly by yourself... with no one noticing.

spans.text: Even back then, you liked to deal with those things discreetly by yourself... with no one noticing.

units.rawText: And after we were reunited, you were the same way. Hide it all down in your heart, where one would know not.
units.displayText: And after we were reunited, you were the same way. Hide it all down in your heart, where one would know not.

spans.text: And after we were reunited, you were the same way. Hide it all down in your heart, where one would know not.

units.rawText: Even if I take your hand, I don't know what decisions you'll make, where you'll next disappear to...
units.displayText: Even if I take your hand, I don't know what decisions you'll make, where you'll next disappear to...

spans.text: Even if I take your hand, I don't know what decisions you'll make, where you'll next disappear to...

units.rawText: What a most worrisome star.
units.displayText: What a most worrisome star.

spans.text: What a most worrisome star.

units.rawText: So that's how it was, even from back then...
units.displayText: So that's how it was, even from back then...

spans.text: So that's how it was, even from back then...

units.rawText: Was I truly that awful?
units.displayText: Was I truly that awful?

spans.text: Was I truly that awful?

units.rawText: Not awful at all. You were brave. You saved everyone.
units.displayText: Not awful at all. You were brave. You saved everyone.

spans.text: Not awful at all. You were brave. You saved everyone.

units.rawText: A Hubble like that is more precious than anything else in the world.
units.displayText: A Hubble like that is more precious than anything else in the world.

spans.text: A Hubble like that is more precious than anything else in the world.

units.rawText: So, when I saw you again, I made up my mind.
units.displayText: So, when I saw you again, I made up my mind.

spans.text: So, when I saw you again, I made up my mind.

units.rawText: Even if I never really knew what you were thinking, even if you still thought that I didn't understand anything... none of that mattered.
units.displayText: Even if I never really knew what you were thinking, even if you still thought that I didn't understand anything... none of that mattered.

spans.text: Even if I never really knew what you were thinking, even if you still thought that I didn't understand anything... none of that mattered.

units.rawText: What matters is that I—we'll never leave you by yourself ever again.
units.displayText: What matters is that I—we'll never leave you by yourself ever again.

spans.text: What matters is that I—we'll never leave you by yourself ever again.

units.rawText: We'll use every option we have. We'll grasp every straw of hope. From now on, we'll never let you make decisions by yourself... then disappear into the night.
units.displayText: We'll use every option we have. We'll grasp every straw of hope. From now on, we'll never let you make decisions by yourself... then disappear into the night.

spans.text: We'll use every option we have. We'll grasp every straw of hope. From now on, we'll never let you make decisions by yourself... then disappear into the night.

units.rawText: We'll do it together, alright? Even if we think differently, even if anyone feels we have no future together... that's alright, too.
units.displayText: We'll do it together, alright? Even if we think differently, even if anyone feels we have no future together... that's alright, too.

spans.text: We'll do it together, alright? Even if we think differently, even if anyone feels we have no future together... that's alright, too.

units.rawText: We have the Professor. We have Anna, Persicaria, and everyone thinking about you at the Oasis, too. And the little guy who likes you, too.
units.displayText: We have the Professor. We have Anna, Persicaria, and everyone thinking about you at the Oasis, too. And the little guy who likes you, too.

spans.text: We have the Professor. We have Anna, Persicaria, and everyone thinking about you at the Oasis, too. And the little guy who likes you, too.

units.rawText: Squeak?
units.displayText: Squeak?

spans.text: Squeak?

units.rawText: If it can get along with us well enough, why can't you?
units.displayText: If it can get along with us well enough, why can't you?

spans.text: If it can get along with us well enough, why can't you?

units.rawText: Don't be scared, Hubble.
units.displayText: Don't be scared, Hubble.

spans.text: Don't be scared, Hubble.

units.rawText: We'll go back together... and try it out, alright?
units.displayText: We'll go back together... and try it out, alright?

spans.text: We'll go back together... and try it out, alright?

units.rawText: In the shadow of a shattered planet, a crumbling sea of stars, Hubble's consciousness blurs, and only the sweetness of chocolate remains.
units.displayText: In the shadow of a shattered planet, a crumbling sea of stars, Hubble's consciousness blurs, and only the sweetness of chocolate remains.

spans.text: In the shadow of a shattered planet, a crumbling sea of stars, Hubble's consciousness blurs, and only the sweetness of chocolate remains.

units.rawText: The drifting tether connected to the spaceship pulls a friend lost in a foreign land back into the cabin.
units.displayText: The drifting tether connected to the spaceship pulls a friend lost in a foreign land back into the cabin.

spans.text: The drifting tether connected to the spaceship pulls a friend lost in a foreign land back into the cabin.

units.rawText: The space station outside the Starsphere meticulously records on. The dark purple Starsphere shrinks with blinding speed, dispersing and leaving only Jiutian's original cosmic background. The laws of spacetime take hold again, and only a singular drifting spaceship remains.
units.displayText: The space station outside the Starsphere meticulously records on. The dark purple Starsphere shrinks with blinding speed, dispersing and leaving only Jiutian's original cosmic background. The laws of spacetime take hold again, and only a singular drifting spaceship remains.

spans.text: The space station outside the Starsphere meticulously records on. The dark purple Starsphere shrinks with blinding speed, dispersing and leaving only Jiutian's original cosmic background. The laws of spacetime take hold again, and only a singular drifting spaceship remains.

units.rawText: The dreamscape is illuminated by starlight, and a drifter arrives at the Oasis.
units.displayText: The dreamscape is illuminated by starlight, and a drifter arrives at the Oasis.

spans.text: The dreamscape is illuminated by starlight, and a drifter arrives at the Oasis.

units.rawText: You could say that.
units.displayText: You could say that.

spans.text: You could say that.
